note: OV-A1 Power-up icons. Same frame/size/anchor rules as incoming-art/icons/sprites/static.json. No text baked in.

icon-calm-breath.note: Power-up calm-breath: three calm breath swirls (Quiet Mind: Focus fills faster). 128 x 128 (+ @2x 256), anchor = centre

icon-steady-start.note: Power-up steady-start: a Focus orb already glowing (Warm Up: start every room with some Focus). 128 x 128 (+ @2x 256), anchor = centre

icon-lighter-strike.note: Power-up lighter-strike: a light feather (Swift Strikes: Strikes use less Focus). 128 x 128 (+ @2x 256), anchor = centre

icon-softer-block.note: Power-up softer-block: a raised forearm block (gi sleeve, closed fist) with hits bouncing off (Firm Guard: Blocks stop more of the hit). 128 x 128 (+ @2x 256), anchor = centre
